payload.title: Wedding Destinations in August for a Summer or Winter Wedding
payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more who already know they want an August wedding date (often for leave, school holidays or a family calendar) and are deciding between a northern summer celebration in Europe and a dry season or winter escape closer to home, before they commit to a destination.
payload.goal: Book a consultation with a Wedded Advisor (Speak with a Wedded Advisor).
payload.angle: August means opposite things depending on the hemisphere: peak northern summer in Europe and dry season or winter in Bali, Fiji and New Zealand. Instead of a ranked 'best of' list with recycled weather claims, this page gives 10 unranked destinations we already plan and write about, each with August weather quoted only from that country's official meteorological service, the honest trade-off of choosing August there, and the exact questions to put to a venue about heat, crowds, peak season and guests flying from Australia. It is a decision tool, not a mood board.
must_include: Direct-answer intro (2 to 3 sentences) naming that August is northern summer in Europe and dry season or winter in the Indo-Pacific, followed by exactly 4 one-sentence takeaways

How to choose an August destination: heat, crowds and peak season framed as questions to ask a venue; guests' travel from Australia; Australian school holidays posed as a question to check (no dates stated)

Exactly 10 unranked entries in this order or grouped by hemisphere, each using the same template: why August suits it or the trade-off; August weather only as the named official national met service states it, linked at the claim; August considerations as venue questions; link to our guide. Entries: Greek islands (Santorini, Mykonos, Crete) -> link /destinations/europe/greece (northern summer); Lake Como -> link /destinations/europe/italy/lake-como-wedding (northern summer); Amalfi Coast -> link /destinations/europe/italy/amalfi-coast-wedding (northern summer); Tuscany -> link /destinations/europe/italy/tuscany-wedding (northern summer); France -> link /destinations/europe/france (northern summer); Portugal -> link /destinations/europe/portugal (northern summer); Switzerland -> link /destinations/europe/switzerland (northern summer); Bali -> link /destinations/asia/bali (dry season); Fiji -> link /destinations/oceania/fiji (dry season); New Zealand -> link /destination-weddings/get-married-in-new-zealand (southern winter)
FAQ (4 to 6 questions, e.g. is August peak season in Europe, where is it dry in August, is August winter in New Zealand, can we have a symbolic ceremony abroad)

Close with one Wedded Advisor line from brand-facts 'Claims we can make', e.g. 'One Wedded Advisor, start to finish, works in your time zone and quotes in AUD.' plus the Speak with a Wedded Advisor CTA
avoid: Prices, 'From AUD' figures or any cost comparison
'Best', 'top' or any ranking or numbering that implies order of merit
Statistics (visitor numbers, rainfall averages, temperatures) not quoted directly from the named official met service
Venue names unless they come from our own live pages
Research talk (e.g. 'we analysed', 'according to our research', SERP references)
Mexico, the Caribbean, Africa and the Middle East; draft-only guides (Hawaii, Mauritius, Seychelles, Santorini/Mykonos/Crete drafts) as entry links
Stating Australian school holiday dates, flight times or visa rules
Competitor wording or claims; em dashes; US spelling
AI images of any real destination
payload.cannibalisation_check: No existing URL targets 'wedding destinations august'. Nearest: /expert-advice/a-guide-on-where-to-go-on-honeymoon-in-august (honeymoon intent, not wedding; link to it once in the guest travel or FAQ section as 'make it a honeymoon'). /7-gorgeous-in-season-wedding-flowers-for-the-august-bride is flowers (Australian season), different intent. Country timing drafts (/destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-greece, /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-bali) own country-level timing; this page owns the cross-destination August intent and should hand off to them once live.
